why: AC-6: a column header naming a band of floors, read as the two levels it runs between; a header naming anything else reads as none. `GF EL` and `6F EL` are F-RCC6-BNBC S-25's section marks, where EL says the number beside it is an elevation and nothing about which storey; `3RD & 4TH` and `ROOF-SRR` are S-11's own band headers — a LIST of two consecutive floors, and a band one end of which names a label no level roster places (`GF & 5TH` is why the list must be consecutive: two floors listed say nothing about the four between them).
